settings.question: Does Sleek work with my existing calendar?
settings.answer: Yes! Sleek automatically syncs with Apple Calendar, Google Calendar, Outlook and all popular calendars. All appointments are updated in real-time.

settings.question: How many clients can I have?
settings.answer: No limit on the number of clients! You can have unlimited clients in your database, even on the Starter plan. The limit only applies to the number of appointments per month.

settings.question: How does the AI assistant work?
settings.answer: Our AI assistant automatically answers customer questions 24/7, helps them book appointments, sends reminders, and provides support in multiple languages. The AI learns from your data to provide personalized experiences.

settings.question: Can I cancel at any time?
settings.answer: Absolutely! No contracts or commitments. You can cancel your subscription anytime with one click. Your data remains accessible for 30 days after cancellation.

settings.question: Is the setup complicated?
settings.answer: Not at all! Most users set up Sleek in less than 10 minutes. Follow our simple wizard that guides you step by step. We also offer free setup assistance for Enterprise users.

settings.question: What types of notifications can I send?
settings.answer: You can send SMS and email notifications for: appointment confirmations, reminders 24h before, post-appointment follow-ups, birthday messages, promotions and custom messages of your choice.

settings.question: Is my data secure?
settings.answer: Absolutely! We use bank-level SSL encryption, comply with GDPR regulations, conduct regular security audits and backup data daily. Your data is in safe hands.

settings.question: What's the difference between plans?
settings.answer: The main difference is in the setup fee, monthly cost, and included features. All plans have access to basic features. Professional adds AI assistant and advanced analytics, while Enterprise offers dedicated support and custom integrations.
